brand.tagline: A greener world from a small daily saving
brand.conservation: 1 Taka Tree Plantation — a greener world from a small daily saving. Serving the environment and humanity since 2019.

home.storyTitle: The idea that started our journey
home.storyP1: "1 Taka Tree Plantation" is an environmental volunteer organization founded on 11 June 2019. From the day it began, it has worked without pause to protect the environment. The idea is simple and powerful: each person saves just one taka a day, so in thirty days the saving is thirty taka. With those thirty taka, at least one tree is planted each month.
home.storyP2: If this campaign can reach Bangladesh's 160 million people, one taka saved each day can plant 160 million trees a month. Through this vast effort we can raise the country's forest cover to 25%. From this far-reaching idea and dream, the journey of "1 Taka Tree Plantation" began.
home.missionTitle: We are not only planting trees—we are building the future
home.feature1Body: 1 Taka Tree Plantation does not stop at planting a tree. It also makes sure every planted tree is cared for and grows.
home.feature2Body: To make people aware of environmental protection and to grow members' skills, the organization has already run several successful campaigns across the country.
home.feature3Body: Alongside the environment, we work for people without fortune or a home. We believe this small gift may change a life. Who can say—among them may be the next Justice Hossain or A. P. J. Abdul Kalam.
home.howTitle: How your 1 taka creates a vast change
home.howBody:
The idea is simple—you give 1 taka a day, 30 taka a month. Alone it may feel small, but the strength of unity is immense!
If 100 people give 30 taka a month, the fund holds 3,000 taka (30 * 100 = 3,000).
When a family of 2,000 or 10,000 people is built, that shared fund can put a smile on the faces of people in need, alongside the environment.
home.ctaTitle: Join this large family of patriots today!
home.ctaBody: More than 4,183 fortunate people have already joined, giving one taka a day to help build a better world. Do you want to be part of this work? Your 1 taka a day may change a life and save a world.
